contexts.text: This style (of the Word) was venerated for its antiquity... and what was not written in this style they did not venerate as Divine.
When (the Ancients) looked at the moon, they were in like manner penetrated with a certain holy veneration, because the moon = spiritual love.
As, in the Glorification of the Lord by man, there are both holy veneration and humiliation, the man is then in a state to receive the influx of good from the Lord...
To be venerated by praises () = that to Him alone belong glory and thanksgiving; for to be venerated by praises, when said of Jehovah, = that He is to be celebrated and worshipped.
This spiritual life lies hidden... and produces what is holy and reverential for the Lord, for love and faith in Him, for the Word, and for all the other things of the Church.
Those who (here) have been in any conjunction by veneration, etc. meet after death...
(The infernals) are forms of... menaces against those who do not revere them... But when others commend, revere, and worship them, their faces... appear as it were glad.
In these (worst) Hells are those who had been in the love of self, and, from that, in... hatred and revenge against those who did not venerate and worship them.
They ate and drank in gladness, and with reverence.
To honour father and mother, in the spiritual sense, = to venerate and love God and the Church.
This love grows according to the virtues which one esteems and reverences... Every virtue, such as mercy, justice, magnanimity, is attended with reverence and love.
The spiritual (have not love to the Lord); but they have veneration, and esteem, which are confirmed through the truths of faith.
The delight of the love of dominating for the sake of... the veneration, and as it were the adoration, of self, is an infernal delight.
In this kind of profanation are those who, before the world, venerate holy things... and at home deride them.
That the head (of the Papists) is adored as a god... is evident from their veneration of him upon the knees... which veneration, or rather adoration, follows from this: that he can open Heaven...
